name: Carnelia
title: Wanderer
description: The former Master Maid of Candle Square and the eldest daughter of the Rhys family. Bound by the curse of immortality, she is incapable of dying and has grown indifferent to the happiness found in life. After a long disappearance, she has returned to NOA to free herself from the curse.
introduction:
The former Master Maid of Candle Square and the eldest daughter of House Rhys.
Bears the <color=#2A80D8>curse of immortality</color>.

After vanishing without warning alongside the <color=#2A80D8>Light of Dawn</color>, the symbol of the Master Maid, she has returned to NOA as a Journey member in hopes of lifting the curse.

Because of the curse, Carnelia sees herself as fundamentally different from ordinary people. Her deepest wish is to free herself from it and prove her own <color=#2A80D8>normalcy</color> by finally being able to embrace death.
Though she treasures the time she spent at Candle Square, she believes she can never return. In her eyes, she abandoned everything and ran away for her own sake, leaving the consequences for others to bear.

She was especially fond of Claire during her time as Master Maid, and she continues to carry a deep sense of guilt toward her younger sister, Bell, believing she was never able to be the <color=#2A80D8>good sister</color> Bell deserved.
